description: Object type for type=adapter adapter_type=lmdb conf entries.

index.description: Secondary (adapter-index) tuning for LMDB - how non-eq index cursors estimate their cardinality for OR/AND cursor-merge ordering. Unrelated to limits, which governs request/scan throttling.
index.label: Index

isModelLocation.description: If specified, this adapter can hold _AdaptiveModel_ objects. The appropriate core objects associated with Adaptive Models will be added automatically for this adapter. Compiled models are cached on this adapter instance: a model adapter that uses this location loads on* once and reuses that compile until this location adapter is recreated. Replacing an _AdaptiveModel_ object does not recompile a live model by itself.
isModelLocation.label: Is Model Location
